title: Honest placement words and lossless table properties
gate: P0 hygiene; AUD4 N1, N2, N3, N4, W4; offline checks only

report.WORKS: BOM UTF-16 tables offer placement; words distinguish preparation from mapping; cells survive headers.
report.INPUTS: Tweed public test_only shapefile ZIP; a temporary copy with an unresolvable .prj.
report.GAPS: No live map, browser, database, processor-image or combined-runtime qualification.

before: This table is UTF-16 text. Its rows are placed on the map only from UTF-8 or
Windows-1252 text, so that each placed row cites its exact bytes. Save the table as CSV UTF-8 and add it
again; this original stays kept unchanged.
N1.change: Removed both obsolete gates, their helper, constant and Studio declaration.
N1.unchanged: Server BOM-less UTF-16 refusal and byte-range checks; LE/BE regressions pass.

before: Building ground outlines are placed on the map when the file states an EPSG system;
otherwise its reading is kept as evidence.
after: Building ground outlines may be prepared when the file states a usable horizontal EPSG system
and holds supported ground geometry. The outline file's own line says whether it reaches the map;
otherwise its reading is kept as evidence.

before: CityJSON building ground outlines are placed on the map when the file states an EPSG system;
otherwise, and for glTF, the reading is kept as evidence.
after: CityJSON building ground outlines may be prepared when the file states a usable horizontal EPSG system
and holds supported ground geometry. The outline file's own line says whether it reaches the map;
otherwise, and for glTF, the reading is kept as evidence.

N3.before: Its line in the batch says how many rows were placed and how many were skipped, and why.
after: Its line in the batch says how many rows were prepared and how many were skipped, and why.
That GeoJSON file is then taken in as its own item in this batch, and its own line says whether it is

W4.before: stores M or MultiPatch shapes, or its shapes and records differ in number
W4.after_count_mismatch: its shapes and records differ in number
W4.unchanged: Type 18 remains not_converted; M/MultiPatch remain refused; supported Z geometry stays intact.

N4.before: A generated fallback could overwrite another source cell or take a later literal header's name.
N4.after: Reserve every original header, then allocate against reserved and previously used property names.
N4.assertions: Every cell survives, order and first literal names stay, output is deterministic.

studio.reason: Both gates and old N2/N3 words reproduced.
